name: minimal-git-server
description_en: Lightweight git server with a basic CLI to manage repositories, supporting multiple accounts and running in a container. `MIT` `Docker`
description: Minimal git server running in a container (docker, podman...)
readme_preview:
Originally inspired by https://github.com/jkarlosb/git-server-docker

This tool lets you run a minimal git server with a basic CLI to manage repositories, all in a container based on a single configuration file.

- support multiple accounts (config.yml) - basic CLI to manage repositories (list/create/rename/remove/...) - easy to use in scripts - tested on docker and podman
